description:
Powerful RWD 250W brushless motor, propels the scooter to a max speed of 12mph, travels up to 8-10 miles and conquer 15% hills. The motor on the rear wheel achieves a faster start, smooth turning and stable riding.

The Utmost Safety - Features anti-lock electronic brake and rear fender foot brake, ensuring user safety when in use. The headlight provides a wider range and the functional brake light makes you can be seen at night.

Light & Foldable - With a total weight of 26lbs and two-second folding design, the electric scooter can be easily stored in a car or on public transport. It is a perfect option for teenagers and adults to go around campus or go out for a short journey.

Clear LED Display - The intuitive display shows the essentials: mode, current speed, and remaining battery capacity. The integrative power button next to the right handle makes the scooter operate easily and handily.

Elegant Cordless - Simple designs tend to be timeless. scooter is designed as cordless, simple and modern, which makes it a stylish scooter in the market.
